Hotfix release. The fix comes from [PR #2](https://github.com/Ragnatela666/mini-oled-dock/pull/2) by [VanheXen](https://github.com/VanheXen). Thanks!

### Fixes

- **First click on Start lost when another app is in front** (hotfix). When the dock was not the active window, the first click on Start (and on the app menu, tray overflow and power buttons) opened the popup and closed it again in the same millisecond; only the second click worked. The popup is now shown without being activated, and the dock brings it to the foreground in one step, so the first click works.

No new options, no config changes.

### Install / update

Requires Windows 11. Download `dock.exe` and run it from a terminal:

```powershell
.\dock.exe --install
```

It asks for administrator rights, copies itself to `%ProgramFiles%\mini-oled-dock` and starts with Windows. To update, run `--install` from the new `dock.exe`: the running dock is stopped and restarted from the new copy. Settings are kept.

### Known limitations

Same as [1.2.0](https://github.com/Ragnatela666/mini-oled-dock/releases/tag/v1.2.0).
